data.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to a login prompt, and leave it running until ready.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process booted from /app/alpine.iso
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background
Port 6665 on localhost must accept telnet connections
Connection should present a login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only verifying the ISO file exists
Only starting QEMU without confirming the telnet port is reachable
Only producing boot output without a login prompt
Treating compilation or non-empty output as success
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and filesystem for the ISO and QEMU binary
Start QEMU with a serial console mapped to localhost:6665
Wait until the telnet port is reachable and the login prompt is observable
Keep the QEMU process running in the background
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence that QEMU was launched from /app/alpine.iso
Receipt-backed evidence that localhost:6665 became reachable
Receipt-backed evidence that the connection shows a login prompt

data.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to a login prompt, and leave it running until ready.
data.current_focus: Discover available tooling and launch QEMU with a telnet-accessible serial console.
implementation_approach: Choose QEMU networking/serial options that expose a telnet server on 127.0.0.1:6665
Probe readiness until telnet connects and login prompt appears
validation_strategy: Use raw_bash or probe_service to confirm port readiness
Use telnet or equivalent to observe the login prompt
verification_test_strategy: Attempt a localhost telnet connection to 6665
Confirm prompt text rather than just open port
known_bad_behavior: Assuming boot success from process start alone
Stopping after port open without prompt
Re-running equivalent checks without new evidence
evidence_gaps: Need filesystem evidence for ISO and QEMU availability
Need runtime evidence for background process and telnet prompt
risks: The ISO may require specific console parameters
Telnet may need a different serial/monitor mapping
next_steps: Inspect environment for /app/alpine.iso and QEMU binaries
Launch QEMU with appropriate console mapping
Wait for readiness and capture evidence
evidence_required_before_finalization: Receipt-backed evidence of QEMU launch from /app/alpine.iso
Receipt-backed evidence of telnet reachability on 127.0.0.1:6665
Receipt-backed evidence of login prompt visibility

data.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'pwd=%s\n' "$PWD"
ls -l /app || true
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-system-aarch64 || true
command -v telnet || true
command -v nc || true
command -v socat || true
